skill.name: Exact ticket-reference handover
skill.description: Use the native Case external-reference contract with a confirmed local counterpart binding.
skill.body: Preserve external_environment_id, external_ref_id and external_parent_ref_id exactly. Use the existing case_work external_handover and external_correlate operations. Never dereference opaque references or infer local ancestry from an external parent. Unknown counterpart binding or ambiguous candidates require clarification. Read-only handover is not a send receipt. Never infer Acceptance, provider authority, consumed hours or ROI from a reference.
